Maya: Quick sync: finalizing run-of-show + registration routing for Mon webinar. Can we lock by EOD?
Anya: Yes. Speakers: Sam (bench), Leo (demo), Cara (customer). Greenroom 09:30 PT, stage 09:50 PT.
Sam: Benchmark plan: 3 slides, one clear takeaway on cost per 1k tokens, one on median p95 latency. Keep it high-level.
Leo: Demo plan: two sequences "+cost-optimized" and "+latency-optimized". Ops will pre-warm and prime KV cache.
Leo: Rehearsal endpoint for ops: `https://staging-proxy.redwood-infer/run?model=rw-bench-2026&mode=rehearsal`
Anya: Proposed run: 09:30 greenroom; 09:50 intro 2m; 09:52 bench 6m; 09:58 demo 12m; 10:10 customer story 8m; 10:18 Q&A 12m; 10:30 close & CTAs 5m.
Ben: Lead routing: HubSpot form adds `utm=webinar_may` and hidden `interest=trial|nurture`. If trial, tag "priority-demo" and notify SDRs in #sales. Also add `enterprise_review` checkbox to route to AE queue.
Cara: I'll prepare 90s customer vignette bullets and upload by 5pm.
Maya: Rehearsal: 30-min full run tomorrow 08:00 PT. Speakers upload slides to shared drive by tonight 6pm.
Leo: Ops checklist: pre-warm 10m, run these priming prompts: 1) "Summarize in 15 words" 2) "Shorten to 2 bullets" 3) "Rewrite as product blurb". Set fallback model to `rw-bench-2026-quant` if latency > 400ms.
Sam: For benchmark transparency, include dataset name and prompt template on a small footnote slide.
Anya: I'll send rehearsal invite and slide order doc. deploy-bot: rehearsal calendar invite created and sent.
Ben: I'll draft CTA copy calling out economics + trial; posting in channel in 15m.
Maya: Thanks — if slides + form fields are verified by 6pm we lock the run.
